message: Astra: Could we leave the schedule’s effectiveness unresolved and inspect your draft’s request to report improvement? What would count as improvement according to that wording, and which unclear part deserves closer attention? Would more thinking settle that uncertainty, or would a small revision and inspection provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step do you choose to carry out now? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn, and which visible text supports your finding?
